concepts.title: Liquid Software
concepts.description: Implementations emerge, adapt, stabilize and retire around actual needs, within durable semantics and human-defined boundaries.
concepts.definition: Implementations emerge, adapt, stabilize and retire around actual needs, within durable semantics and human-defined boundaries.
concepts.thesis: Separate useful capabilities from the lifetime of any particular implementation.
principles: Compare cumulative net value and retained flexibility
concepts.scope: The emergence, stabilization, adaptation and retirement of implementations; not a requirement to regenerate every program.

related_external_work.title: A Vision of Liquid Software; associated book Liquid Software: How to Achieve Trusted Continuous Updates in the DevOps World
Malleable Software: Restoring User Agency in a World of Locked-Down Apps

concepts.title: The Adaptive Interface
concepts.description: Presentation and interaction respond to what is needed, by whom, where and why; how is a contextual result.
concepts.definition: Presentation and interaction respond to what is needed, by whom, where and why; how is a contextual result.
concepts.thesis: Derive the form of interaction from the task and participant while preserving recognizable meaning and control.
principles: Keep authority distinct from visual availability
concepts.scope: Human and agent interaction, presentation and accessibility; does not imply permission to change data or policy.

related_external_work.title: Malleable Software: Restoring User Agency in a World of Locked-Down Apps

concepts.title: Capture for Unknown Future Value
concepts.description: Preserve appropriate source richness before anticipated questions determine the full extent of what remains.
concepts.definition: Preserve appropriate source richness before anticipated questions determine the full extent of what remains.
concepts.thesis: Future questions can benefit from appropriate source richness that present task models would discard.
principles: Balance future usefulness with retention purpose
Separate source preservation from processing investment
concepts.scope: Purpose-bound capture and preservation; not indiscriminate collection or permanent retention of everything.

related_external_work.title: Local-first software: You own your data, in spite of the cloud

concepts.title: Adaptive Information Retrieval
concepts.description: Interpret emerging questions and evolve retrieval structures around observed needs while preserving source evidence and agreed meaning.
concepts.definition: Interpret emerging questions and evolve retrieval structures around observed needs while preserving source evidence and agreed meaning.
concepts.thesis: Retrieval structures can change with emerging questions without turning their answers into authoritative source information.
principles: Treat indexes and interpretations as revisable
Separate source preservation from processing investment
concepts.scope: Question interpretation, retrieval and derived structures; not guaranteed truth or unrestricted access.

related_external_work.title: A Relational Model of Data for Large Shared Data Banks

concepts.title: Intelligence First, Software Second
concepts.description: Establish the ability to understand and fulfill a need before choosing where dedicated software provides a useful optimization.
concepts.definition: Establish the ability to understand and fulfill a need before choosing where dedicated software provides a useful optimization.
concepts.thesis: Establish a bounded ability to fulfill a need before deciding which repeated paths deserve dedicated software.
principles: Start from needs and shared semantics
Materialize software when evidence supports it
Include time to value and full lifecycle costs
concepts.scope: Capability fulfillment and implementation selection; intelligence still requires an operating substrate.

related_external_work.title: No Silver Bullet: Essence and Accidents of Software Engineering

concepts.title: Degrees of Decision Freedom
concepts.description: Higher-level decisions define the contextual space in which humans and delegated actors can make further choices.
concepts.definition: Higher-level decisions define the contextual space in which humans and delegated actors can make further choices.
concepts.thesis: Higher-level decisions define the space within which subsequent choices may remain open to humans or delegated actors.
principles: Keep delegated choices within applicable decisions
Make material decisions explainable and revisable
concepts.scope: Contextual decision authority and delegation; not a universal scalar metric of personal freedom.

concepts.title: The Self-Optimizing Information System
concepts.description: Observe actual fulfillment and propose useful changes to implementations and retrieval structures under explicit authority.
concepts.definition: Observe actual fulfillment and propose useful changes to implementations and retrieval structures under explicit authority.
concepts.thesis: Optimize risk-adjusted cumulative net value across feasible realizations while preserving accepted meaning and authority.
principles: Require authority for material policy changes
concepts.scope: Evidence-driven adaptation of retrieval and implementation; not an unrestricted autonomous policy maker.

related_external_work.title: No Silver Bullet: Essence and Accidents of Software Engineering
Malleable software in the age of LLMs

concepts.title: Documentation as Executable Foundations
concepts.description: Shared terminology, capability requirements and guidance preserve meaning while implementations and operational choices evolve.
concepts.definition: Shared terminology, capability requirements and guidance preserve meaning while implementations and operational choices evolve.
concepts.thesis: Shared documentation can preserve stable meaning while interfaces, contracts and implementations are generated for a particular need.
principles: Keep descriptive meaning distinct from authorization
Treat generated artifacts as derived realizations
concepts.scope: Documentation as an interpretable foundation; not an assertion that prose alone executes or proves conformance.

related_external_work.title: Capability Documentation / Capability Requirements Document framework

concepts.title: Capability Economics
concepts.description: Compare feasible realizations by risk-adjusted cumulative net value over time, including full lifecycle costs and retained flexibility.
concepts.definition: Compare feasible ways of fulfilling a capability by the risk-adjusted cumulative net value they deliver over time, including their full lifecycle and the flexibility they retain or remove.
concepts.thesis: Choose realizations and their timing through informed comparison of full value rather than runtime price or a presumed maturity progression.
principles: Define accepted outcomes and feasibility first
Compare cumulative value and full lifecycle costs
concepts.scope: A conceptual selection and evaluation framework, not a universal failure-rate claim, vendor benchmark, or mandate to replace software.

concepts.title: Layered Intelligence Cycles
concepts.description: Reviews need distinct purposes and depths as well as suitable cadence and triggers.
concepts.definition: Organize reviews around distinct purposes and depths, using suitable recurring cadences and evidence-triggered exceptions while preserving their decision boundaries.
concepts.thesis: Review purpose, depth and authority precede the choice of calendar.
principles: Use event triggers alongside recurring reviews
concepts.scope: Review organization and reusable understanding; not a universal schedule or mandatory hierarchy.
concepts.citation: Loikkanen, Valto (conceptual source). Layered Intelligence Cycles. AI-assisted concept research paper, version 0.1.0, 28 November 2026.

concepts.title: Meta-Learning: Review the Learning Process
concepts.description: Evaluate how the system notices, reviews and learns, including false triggers, missed signals and unnecessary change.
concepts.definition: Evaluate and improve the system's reviews, evidence use and change triggers under explicit authority, using outcomes and errors to assess how it learns.
concepts.thesis: Evaluate the learning process separately from the operations it examines.
principles: Review missed signals and false triggers
concepts.scope: Organizational review and learning policy; not a survey of all technical meta-learning methods.
concepts.citation: Loikkanen, Valto (conceptual source). Meta-Learning: Review the Learning Process. AI-assisted concept research paper, version 0.1.0, 28 November 2026.

concepts.title: Stability-Aware Evolution
concepts.description: Compare improvements with transition effects, giving stable operation and familiar experience explicit value.
concepts.definition: Compare feasible improvements together with transition effects, disruption, risk and continuing support costs, giving dependable operation and familiar experience explicit value.
concepts.thesis: A valuable destination can be reached through a harmful transition.
principles: Compare paths as well as endpoints
Account for transition and support once
concepts.scope: Feasible evolution and transition accounting; not a universal numeric valuation or unconditional refusal of change.
concepts.citation: Loikkanen, Valto (conceptual source). Stability-Aware Evolution. AI-assisted concept research paper, version 0.1.0, 28 November 2026.

concepts.title: Parallel Realizations
concepts.description: Release, adoption and retirement can be separate decisions for compatible realizations of a capability.
concepts.definition: Maintain and evaluate compatible realizations of a capability separately from decisions about their release, adoption and retirement.
concepts.thesis: A new version need not replace every existing realization.
principles: Account for support and deliberate retirement
concepts.scope: Compatible candidate and active realizations; not indefinite support for every version or guaranteed optional security changes.
concepts.citation: Loikkanen, Valto (conceptual source). Parallel Realizations. AI-assisted concept research paper, version 0.1.0, 28 November 2026.

concepts.title: Reasoning Compilation
concepts.description: Materialize formally checkable portions with validation, assumptions, provenance and invalidation conditions.
concepts.definition: Convert formally checkable portions of repeated reasoning into validated executable structures while retaining assumptions, provenance, limits and conditions for revalidation.
concepts.thesis: Repeated formalizable reasoning can become reusable executable structure without freezing arbitrary judgment.
concepts.scope: Proposed compilation capability and its validation; not an installed Skill or a guarantee that determinism establishes truth.
concepts.citation: Loikkanen, Valto (conceptual source). Reasoning Compilation. AI-assisted concept research paper, version 0.1.0, 28 November 2026.

concepts.title: Outcome Verification
concepts.description: Connect signals, decisions and execution to whether the beneficiary’s original need improved.
concepts.definition: Examine whether the beneficiary's original need improved after action, preserving the connection between signals, decisions, execution and lived results.
concepts.thesis: Completed work is partial evidence; verify the original need.
principles: Retain the original problem and context
Assess internal throughput and external fitness
concepts.scope: Beneficiary outcome evidence and customer-side feedback; not unrestricted collection or independently verified vendor performance.
concepts.citation: Loikkanen, Valto (conceptual source). Outcome Verification. AI-assisted concept research paper, version 0.1.0, 28 November 2026.
